It worked at first. I like to grind fresh beans for my coffee though, and after 3 months, the filter became progressively clogged. Maybe some of the grinds were too fine and accumulated over time. There is no way to clean it once this happens, and then the coffee drips maddeningly slow. I had to throw it away. It seems to be a major design flaw that you can't somehow clean the mesh. Given the price I don't think it's worth it.

I absolutely love this. It's my first time owning a pourover and I went with the metal on purpose because I'm going back to school next year and am going to be commuting for about an hour, so I wanted something that I could just throw in my bag without having to worry about it getting damaged. It arrived in perfect condition and seems extremely durable and sturdy; I have no worries whatsoever that it will get damaged while tumbling around in my backpack. Another thing I was really pleased with is how easy it is to clean. I didn't get a good look at the pictures before I ordered it, so I was imagining the metal mesh to be similar to a tea strainer, but actually the mesh on this is much finer so that the water can get through without any coffee grounds getting through. My coffee was finely ground, and even then, not a single ground was in my cup. I thought it was going to be a little difficult to clean, the way tea strainers are sometimes difficult, but it was extremely easy to rinse out and a quick scrub got rid of all the coffee residue. I would definitely recommend this to anyone, ESPECIALLY because it doesn't require any kind of filter (paper or otherwise) and therefore is better for the environment than the regular coffee makers that I've been using all my life.

One more thing: I got this for myself because I'm only planning on making single servings of coffee, but I realized when I was using it that it's actually quite large, so I could easily see filling it up

! week ago i would have given this 5 stars and rave reviews. I received this for Christmas (my son purchased it on Amazon)  and was very pleased with how well it works. Now the bad part and it's pretty bad. The support ring and handle have now completely detached from the body of the dripper. There was some kind of tacking procedure used to secure them as one unit and now after 3 weeks it has totally failed. There is no way to reattach the rim. That effective ends the use of the dripper.  I am very disappointed because it is a marvelous idea and even looks nice. The maker of this device needs to address that as it looks like the attachment is not consistent in it's strength

This product is of awesome size and materials, but as a proponent and long time user of drip coffee makers I will have to say that this one does not work nearly as well as claimed, it is very messy to clean, I found that a #1 cone coffee filter works wonders and clean up is a snap and does no harm at all to my self blended coffee,  flavor or aroma ( Cafe Du Monde coffee with Chicory and New Mexico Pinion Nut coffee in a nearly  49 / 51 % mix med.grind. ).  I put this information only because, if you're not enjoying your coffee's as much as I am mine, you need to experiment and find something you can truly enjoy, I don't drink coffee just for the sake of drinking coffee and if you decide to get this very well built drip coffee maker, get the filters , works great!!

When I received this pack of filters, I found that the filter fit perfectly in the Keurig machine. I Installed the Geesta filter after my first cup in the morning to see if I could tell the difference between the old filter and the new Geesta. To be honest, I could not. But that is not a bad thing. The filters are exactly alike to my eyes and the original Keurig filter did a fine job as did the new one from Geesta.

One thing I really liked about this replacement pack is that each filter is individually packaged in its own air tight envelope preventing other contaminants from touching down on it in an open package possibly spoiling its efficacy before even using it the first time.

I am not doing a cost comparison here but if these are less expensive than what you get from Keurig directly, you will definitely save some money by purchasing these and still get a great cup of java.
